physicalNotes: Radius 0.11776272 Jupiter radii from Lacedelli et al. 2024 (2024A&A...692A.238L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract): 8,419.1 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00654441 Jupiter masses (Lacedelli et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024A&A...692A.238L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
